notes.title: 0.99.43 - The Hunting! Hotfix
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] The issue where the Cancel Movement function worked even in abnormal situations has been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.42 - The Hunting! Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] The Hospital UI has been updated.
[*] An NPC has been added to the Hospital.
[*] Hospital-related dialogues have been added.
[*] Buff icon images have been updated.
[*] The English name of the Shaman has been changed.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.41 - The Hunting! Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes :[/b]

[list]
[*] A feature has been added to the Correctional Facility that allows traits to be locked. Locked traits will not change or disappear.
[*] When leveling up, heroes will now gain only 1 positive trait instead of gaining both 1 positive and 1 negative trait.
[*] Even at the maximum level, heroes will continue to level up, and each level-up will grant 1 positive trait.
[*] When a hero dies during battle, they will now gain 1 negative trait.
[*] Religious activities have been removed, and Meditation has been changed to Rest.
[*] Traits related to religious activities have been replaced with other traits.
[*] The NPCs for Rest (formerly Meditation) and the Correctional Facility have been changed.
[*] Dialogue scripts related to these changes have been added.
[*] The location of the Journal object has been moved to the former location of Religious Activities.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.40 - The Hunting! Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes :[/b]

[list]
[*] All heroes have been changed so that only one copy of each hero can exist.
[*] Accordingly, of the heroes you currently own, only the highest-level hero of each type will remain, and the rest will be removed. Any accessories equipped by removed heroes will be stored in the inventory.
[*] The hero recruitment system has been updated. New heroes can now be unlocked by meeting specific conditions.
[*] Fixed an issue where the hospital did not appear properly.
[*] Hospitalized heroes will no longer disappear. You can now discharge them at any time you wish.
[*] Related story content has been added and updated.
[*] Additional conditions are now tracked and saved (such as number of times objects were used, number of hospitalizations, etc.).
[*] The tutorial has been updated to reflect these changes.
[*] Fixed an issue where some monsters’ death animations caused them to shift to another tile.
[*] Several other bugs discovered during the modification process have been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.33 - The Hunting! Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes :[/b]

[list]
[*] Save file names have been removed. Instead, the save file numbers are displayed.
[*] The artifact system has been added. You can access the artifact system after recruiting the rogue, and artifacts provide additional beneficial effects during expeditions.
[*] When a unit dies while in a stunned state, the effect is properly removed.
[*] Some resources have been cleaned up.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.32 - The Hunting! Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes :[/b]

[list]
[*] The Mage’s "Domain Expansion" skill has been changed to an ability that attacks all enemies.
[*] Some enemy monsters’ skills have been changed to target and attack all enemies.
[*] Movement and action point icons have been updated.
[*] The Cleric’s 3D character outfit colors have been changed.
[*] Other bugs discovered during development have been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.31 - The Hunting! Patch Note
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes :[/b]

[list]
[*] The fatigue system has been removed. Objects can now be used regardless of fatigue.
[*] Instead of the fatigue system, current HP is now saved after battles.
[*] Due to the removal of the fatigue system, all heroes’ HP will be fully restored upon first entry into the camp.
[*] If a hero’s HP drops to 0 during battle and the battle ends, that hero will no longer be able to participate in subsequent battles.
[*] When a hero’s HP reaches 0 during exploration, the UI will indicate the hero’s death status.
[*] Meditation now functions to restore HP.
[*] Religious activities now function to restore HP.
[*] Objects that previously restored fatigue now restore HP instead.
[*] Tutorials and dialogues have been updated to reflect the removal of the fatigue system.
[*] Healing skill recovery rates have been generally reduced.
[*] Skill upgrade multipliers have been uniformly increased by 5% per level.
[*] Monster skill attack multipliers have been increased to reflect difficulty scaling.
[*] Some skills that directly reduced movement points have been changed to apply debuffs that reduce movement points instead.
[*] Fixed an intermittent issue where the hero detail window would not close after opening on the expedition selection screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where the BGM did not loop properly.
[*] Additionally, various minor bugs have been fixed as they were discovered.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.30 - The Hunting! Patch Note
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes : [/b]

[list]
[*] The new status effect "Stun" has been added. Accordingly, some skills that previously reduced action points have been changed to apply the Stun status instead.
[*] When the Stun status effect is removed, a buff granting 1 turn of resistance to the next Stun is applied. Therefore, the turn limit on skills that apply Stun has been removed.
[*] The method of equipping accessories has been changed. Now, accessories can be equipped by clicking directly on the accessory slot in the hero’s information window.
[*] Effects of certain accessories have been adjusted.
[*] Data related to heroes’ skills has been adjusted. As a result, all skills currently equipped by heroes have been reset.
[*] If the update is performed while in the middle of an expedition, heroes’ skills may not function properly. To resolve this, you must abandon the expedition and enter the camp once to proceed normally.
[*] As compensation, upon entering the camp, all skill levels held before the patch will be granted at their maximum level.
[*] A button to cancel hero movement during battle has been added. You can now freely cancel movement mid-combat.
[*] Imps, except for the "Modified Imp," no longer self-destruct.
[*] The "Bombardier" monster deals damage to surrounding targets upon death.
[*] Attack power and HP of monsters have been slightly reduced.
[*] Tooltips displaying weapon and armor stats have been added to the hero information window.
[*] Fixed an issue where heroes’ icons were incorrectly displayed when traits were gained through objects during exploration.
[*] Fixed an intermittent issue causing abnormal hero experience gain.
[*] Additional story and journal scripts are in progress.
[*] The outfit colors of some heroes' 3D models have been adjusted to better match their illustrations.
[*] The effects of some heroes’ skills with turn limits have been modified.
[*] The title screen has been updated.
[*] The overall UI structure and data of the game have been changed. Additional issues may remain and will be quickly fixed once discovered.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.21 - The Hunting! Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes : [/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would not proceed properly when the BGM volume was set to 0.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.20 - The Hunting! Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes : [/b]

[list]
[*] Attack power stat has been added to heroes.
[*] Skill damage calculation has been changed (Previous: Skills had fixed damage values / Now: Skills have damage multipliers based on attack power)
[*] Monsters now also have attack power and skill multipliers, similar to heroes.
[*] Hero equipment has been divided into two categories: weapons and armor.
[*] Armor retains the same enhancement effects and functions as before.
[*] Weapons increase a hero's attack power, critical rate, and critical damage.
[*] Both weapons and armor can now be enhanced at the forge.
[*] The skip key for the tutorial has been changed from Spacebar → ESC.
[*] Some stat icons have been updated.
[*] Various bug fixes were applied to address potential issues.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.15 - The Hunting! Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes :[/b]

[list]
[*] Added the ability to skip scripted events using the ESC key.
[*] Fixed bugs related to scripted events.
[*] New scripted events have been added to the Training Grounds, Forge, and Meditation Area.
[*] Final stage data has been partially updated. (It will soon be available for proper gameplay.)
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.14 - The Hunting! Hotfix
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes : [/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where language translations were not applied to the newly added story dialogues.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.13 - The Hunting! Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes : [/b]

[list]
[*] Increased the HP cost of the Warrior Hero's "Smash" skill.
[*] Fixed an issue where the ability of the Ribbon accessory was not functioning correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug where accessories would occasionally disappear when using the training grounds.
[*] Added new story dialogues to the early gameplay. (More will be added in future updates.)
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.12 - The Hunting! Hotfix
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes :[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the boss stage occasionally failed to generate.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.11 - The Hunting! Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes : [/b]

[list]
[*] Re-fixed an issue where the clear status was abnormal after exiting the game following a boss clear.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain boss levels failed to load properly.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed heroes to exceed the maximum level (5).
[*] Traits exceeding the maximum limit will now cause the lowest traits to disappear. Please adjust your traits accordingly before applying the patch.
[*] Fixed an issue where the highlight for acquired traits did not appear correctly on the result screen.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.10 - The Hunting! Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes :[/b]

[list]
[*] Adjusted the patterns of certain boss monsters (Necromancer, Karina).
[*] Fixed an issue where the player's entry direction was not applied correctly in boss levels.
[*] Fixed an issue where the clear status was abnormal after exiting the game following a boss clear.
[*] Added one additional boss for each region.
[*] Changed the boss monster requirements for accessing the final stage.
[*] Fixed an issue where some monsters were not using skills properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where some BGM was not looping correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.06 - The Hunting! Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes : [/b]

[list]
[*] The maximum number of traits that can be acquired is now limited based on hero level. (Level 3: Maximum of 3 beneficial traits and 3 harmful traits.)
[*] Traits acquired upon leveling up are now highlighted on the result screen.
[*] Simplified Chinese translation has been added.
[*] Fixed an issue where some text was not being translated properly.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.05 - The Hunting! Hotfix
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes : [/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Skeleton Mage monster was causing abnormal errors.
[*] Slightly increased the brightness of the background.
[*] Replaced the BGM for Cave and Ruins stages.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.04 - The Hunting! Patch notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes : [/b]

[list]
[*] Reduced monsters' attack power and HP. (Balance adjustments will continue over time.)
[*] Fixed an issue where monsters were incorrectly placed in certain battles during the tutorial stage.
[*] Cave and Ruins stages are no longer displayed when selecting a tutorial battle.
[*] Added transition effects when entering the game from the title screen and when returning to the title screen during gameplay.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.03 - The Hunting! Patch notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes : [/b]

[list]
[*] Base HP slightly increased for Assassin, Priest, Mage, Alchemist, and Thief.
[*] Increased tooltip display speed for traits, items, and parameters.
[*] The hero information screen now displays details on how to change skills.
[*] The activation method for beneficial trait objects has been changed. Instead of failure, "Great Success" has been added. On Great Success, players can choose one out of three traits.
[*] The activation method for harmful trait removal objects has been adjusted. Failure no longer results in no effect. Instead, traits are always removed, but a portion of the gold obtained in the stage will be lost.
[*] Trait-related objects now always have beneficial effects. However, their appearance rate has been reduced.
[*] Fixed an issue where equipped accessories were not visible for heroes admitted to the hospital.
[*] A new function has been added to forcibly retrieve accessories from hospitalized heroes. (Warning: If this action fails, the accessory will be permanently lost. Use with caution.)
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.02 - The Hunting! Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes :[/b] 

[list]
[*] To enhance the distinction between skill levels, all units' attack power and health have been tripled.
[*] As a result, damage-over-time and healing-over-time effects have been adjusted accordingly.
[*] Additionally, the value of 'Add Damage' stats has decreased due to these changes. Adjustments will be made in future updates to improve its effectiveness.
[*] Some hero stats have been slightly adjusted.
[*] Assassin Hero: "Eviscerate" skill cooldown reduced from 3 turns to 1 turn.
[*] Warrior Hero: "Second Wind" skill effect has been changed.
[*] Archer Hero: "Sniping" skill range has been adjusted.
[*] Paladin Hero: "Recovery" skill effect has been changed.
[*] Alchemist Hero: "Dangerous Mix" skill effect has been changed.
[*] Berserker Hero: Overall HP cost for skill usage has been adjusted.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain buff skills were not functioning properly.
[*] The effects of some skills have been changed.
[*] Added simple animations for map transitions.
[*] Added simple animations for battle starts. (These may be further developed in future updates.)
[*] New BGM has been added, and some existing BGM placements have been adjusted.
[*] The base cost for removing traits has been significantly reduced and will now increase based on hero level.
[*] Fixed level object placement errors in certain areas.
[*] Monster placements have been adjusted in some battles to prevent combat from occurring too frequently near entrances.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.01 - The Hunting! Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes :[/b]

[list]
[*] Interacting with healing objects and chests will no longer fail. (The success/fail system has been changed to success/great success.)
[*] Healing objects now visually change after being used.
[*] Reduced the HP cost for Berserker skills that consume health.
[*] Slightly reduced the cost of using the hospital.
[*] Slightly reduced the cost of learning new skills.
[*] Slightly reduced the gold rewards for clearing Hard and Very Hard difficulties.
[*] Adjusted certain props that did not match the background.
[*] Fixed an issue where multiple BGM tracks would play simultaneously after returning to the title screen from an expedition.
[*] New journal entries have been added. More will continue to be introduced in future updates.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.99.00 - The Hunting! Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes : [/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where movement using the mouse click prevented movement with arrow keys.
[*] Fixed an issue where some grass objects could not be passed through.
[*] Fixed a bug causing players to fall in a specific area of the ruins.
[*] Fixed an issue where map movement using arrow keys did not function correctly.
[*] Adjusted rewards for large and small chests.
[*] The Shaman now wears an outfit matching the color of their illustration.
[*] After using a skill, characters will now face one of the four cardinal directions. (Additional related features may be implemented in the future.)
[*] Adjusted the Haldrogora monster's pattern.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain monsters did not use their skills.
[*] Rewards are now granted upon collecting a specific number of journals.
[*] Some journal entries have been revised, and more will be added in future updates.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.98.9 - The Hunting! Hotfix
notes.content:
Patch Notes : 

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where certain terrain could not be clicked for movement during the tutorial stage.
[*] Fixed an issue where language settings were not being saved.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Priest's skill icons were displayed incorrectly.
[*] Adjusted the effects of some of the Priest's skills (Mass Heal, Revive).
[*] Reduced the healing amount of a specific Shaman skill (Salpuri).
[*] Fixed an issue where using a resurrection skill would trigger health recovery twice.
[*] You can now return to the title screen even after starting an adventure.
[*] Fixed an issue where objects were not properly saved after departing on an adventure.
[/list]

notes.title: The Hunting! Early Access Launch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470509/5a8839f04b28b8c68637ab10d62375870beb8170.png[/img]

Hello, this is [b]HusH[/b], the developer of [b]The Hunting![/b]
I am thrilled to finally introduce the game to all of you!

Early Access for [b]The Hunting![/b] officially began on February 14th.

The game is currently playable, but the ending and story elements are still incomplete.
Before the full release, we plan to refine these aspects and make adjustments to certain systems based on player feedback.

If you encounter any bugs or have feedback, please report them via our Discord or community channels.
We will do our best to respond and address them as quickly as possible.

I hope you enjoy playing The Hunting!
Thank you!
